title: Kula Today
heading: Today · Fri 06 Nov
summary: The upslope ran from about 09:45 to about 17:40. A low day for November: the base stayed down near 4,000 ft (normal 4,500–5,500 ft). The evening before, the page called it low, about 4,500 ft, a hit. Midday the base averaged about 4,000 ft by the Kekoa camera, 500 ft lower than the evening's number; the morning update said about 4,600 ft, off by 600 ft. Most of the day the shear line was crossing Kula Highway near Omaopio; furthest north about 12:22, at Pukalani, running toward Kahului. Data gaps: no readings all day from 2 stations (Kahikinui, Nakula); Upper Kahikinui stopped at 07:15; Park HQ stopped at 12:15; Pulehu stopped at 12:25; Keokea stopped at 12:30; Kula Ag stopped at 12:30; Nene Nest stopped at 12:30; Piiholo stopped at 12:30; Summit stopped at 12:30; the Mesonet could not be reached on 15 of 53 updates.
